desc: Parse the input grid dimensions, all building floor counts, and the list of queries (fast I/O).

Build a Kruskal reconstruction tree: edges between cardinally adjacent cells weighted min(F_u,F_v), sorted descending, DSU merges create internal nodes weighted by the edge weight; leaves carry cell ids.
Compute the maximum-bottleneck level B = weight of LCA(u,v) on the reconstruction tree (iterative offline Tarjan LCA with array-based adjacency); handle same-cell queries as |Y-Z|.
For each query output |Y-Z| when B >= min(Y,Z), else Y+Z-2B; verified on sample (10 and 2).
Solution passed all public sample tests, matching expected outputs.
